about: i grew up on guam and now i'm in california becoming a biomedical engineer.
before the lab, i was a cna. taking care of patients is still the reason i do any of this.
i study how materials can release medicine exactly when the body needs it, and how viruses like ev-d68 affect kids.
faith keeps me grounded, and i've played piano and harmonica for six years!
i speak english and tagalog, and i'm learning chamoru!
